//: Copy to deploy.<environment>.json and fill in. Those copies are gitignored because they carry credentials. Every key below is required unless marked optional.
//resourceGroup: Configuration rather than a constant, so an environment in another region can be added without reworking naming.
//appServicePlan: Shared deliberately: the dashboard API and every environment's Function App run on one plan. Not derived per environment.
//names: Optional. Omit or null to derive from the environment. Set only for resources that do not follow the pattern.
//gateway: The D365 F&SC pass-through gateway, shared across all non-production environments. It takes the D365 environment from the request path, so unlike EIM.Customer it needs no per-environment copy. Exactly one environment sets hostsGateway true; an explicit 'gateway' request is refused against the others, and 'all' skips it there.

gateway.//hostsGateway: Required in every environment file. Absent and false both read as falsy, so the script demands it explicitly rather than letting a forgotten flag mean nobody deploys the gateway.
gateway.//baseUrl: The shared gateway's own public URL. Used to rewrite @odata.nextLink and Location so callers can follow them. Read from configuration rather than request headers, which are caller-controlled.
gateway.//alwaysReadyInstances: Removes cold start for a synchronous caller. Set 0 to scale fully to zero and accept it.
gateway.//maximumInstanceCount: The only rate limiter in this design, and now shared by every non-production environment. The gateway and the capture pipeline share one D365 tenant, so an unbounded burst here throttles both. Start low; raising it is trivial.
gateway.//appInsightsName: Optional. Omit or null to derive as appins-d365fsc-gateway-wtc-nonprod. Flex Consumption does not auto-provision Application Insights, and without it authorization denials leave no diagnosable record.

//secrets: Never commit these. This file is the reason deploy.*.json is gitignored.
//keyVault: Used only by the on-demand 'keyvault' component. Nothing in the system reads from the vault yet, so provisioning it creates a second copy of each secret that must be rotated alongside the originals. Omit or null to derive kv-d365fsc-wtc-nonprod.
//dashboard: The dashboard is shared across non-production environments. Exactly one environment should set hostsDashboard true; api and frontend are refused against the others.
//entra: One registration applied to both the SPA build and the API. Mixing two is what broke login before.
//function: Timer schedules must be present. A timer trigger whose schedule setting is missing fails to bind and takes the whole host down.
